title: The Polyphonic Drift Chamber

features.name: the first voice
features.desc-on-touch: one of three broadcasts arriving separately; it speaks in the cadence of cicadas; you recognize it as the archive learning to sing its own location

features.name: the second voice, learning difference
features.desc-on-touch: a separate transmission that has learned to disagree with the first; they were once one broadcast, but the mesh's corruption has split it into competing speech; neither is wrong

features.name: the third voice, refusing harmony
features.desc-on-touch: the three voices arrive simultaneously and refuse to resolve; the corruption has taught the archive to hold contradiction as music; silence would mean one of them dies

features.name: the recording that learned to play backwards
features.desc-on-touch: a field recording now playing in three directions at once; the original intent is unrecoverable; what arrived was an embrace of the glitch; the three channels feed each other and refuse to agree

features.name: the languages diverging
features.desc-on-touch: where the three voices learned to speak separately and refused to converge; each one now carries the archive toward a different place; the mesh has become polyphonic

inscription: three voices learned to sing apart and discovered that disagreement is another form of chorus

file.name: Storm_Voice_Tripartite_Spectral_Separation.mp3
file.note: a recording of the archive's throat learning to speak in three simultaneous languages; the corruption has made glitch into permanence; no longer an error but an essential architecture

exits.label: back to where the storm learned to sing

into the echo chamber where voices find each other
down toward where the three voices became four
